Irish President Visits Scotland, Emphasizing Bilateral Ties

Irish President Catherine Connolly commenced a four-day visit to Scotland, aiming to strengthen bilateral relations. During the visit, she spoke of the strong ties between Ireland and Scotland. The visit's agenda included engagements focused on reinforcing the connection between the two nations.
